claims.statement: The exact rooted branch-product partition, rank formulas, fixed-leaf weight decomposition including root-supported and support-at-branch-root boundary terms, and root-boundary legal-switch descriptions hold for arbitrary finite ordinary trees. They yield a structural reduction only; universal weighted Hall feasibility and the primary complete-sum inequality remain unresolved.
claims.scope: Unconditional structural identities for any finite ordinary tree, chosen root, and fixed selected original-leaf set. The primary target remains the complete original-selector sum under x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2alpha(T)+1; no proof, refutation, or Hall-feasibility result for that target is supplied.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: direct case analysis verifies the branch partition, rank and weight identities, same-support multiplicities, and switch boundary cases. The route supplies no selector-preserving uncrossing or capacitated matching for arbitrary cuts and no proof or eligible full-sum counterexample; Hall failure would not itself refute the scalar primary claim.

limitations: The exact identities only encode the state space and its boundary coupling; the required universal weighted Hall inequalities remain unproved.
